key_insight: Performance gains in LLM-driven evolutionary coding agents are not monolithic: the paper shows these gains can come from distinct mechanisms—new algorithmic structure, re-tuning of existing strategies, and low-level implementation optimizations—and offers ways to disentangle them.
problem_solved: Clarifies what is actually being evolved by systems that pair large language models with evolutionary search, addressing the ambiguity when progress is reported only by best-task scores (i.e., whether gains reflect genuine algorithmic innovation or superficial/code-level changes).
method: Analyze LLM + evolutionary search workflows and formalize a diagnostic taxonomy that classifies code changes (e.g., structural/algorithmic changes, hyper-parameter/heuristic retuning, and implementation-level edits).
Instrument runs with controlled experiments and ablations across representative tasks to measure how different classes of edits contribute to evaluator score improvements.
Use code and behavior comparisons (diffs, performance traces, replays) to attribute improvements to the identified mechanisms and quantify their prevalence.
impact: Gives researchers and practitioners concrete diagnostics to interpret improvements from evolutionary coding agents, helping to distinguish true algorithmic discovery from reimplementation or tuning and guiding better design of search, prompts, and evaluators.
visual_elements: Evolutionary loop diagram: LLM generates code → mutation/variation → evaluator → selection, annotated with what gets measured at each step.
Taxonomy chart: categorizing edits into algorithmic-structure, strategy retuning, and implementation optimizations, with short examples for each.
Before/after code diff + execution trace: side-by-side showing a structural change vs a tuning change and their differing behavioral effects.
Stacked bar / pie charts: breakdown of contribution of each mechanism to score gains across multiple tasks.
paper_title: What Do Evolutionary Coding Agents Evolve?
paper_authors: Nico Pelleriti, Sree Harsha Nelaturu, Zhanke Zhou, Zongze Li, Max Zimmer
